bio: Singgih Susilo Kartono is an Indonesian product designer and the founder of Magno, the wooden-radio brand he launched in 2004, as well as the Spedagi bamboo-bike initiative. A graduate of ITB’s Product Design program, he has received international recognition including the 2008 Japan Good Design Award and 2009 Brit Insurance Design Award, and has used Pasar Papringan to advance village revitalization.

Rina Andriani, S.Sos., M.M. is the Lurah of Nusukan in Surakarta’s Banjarsari district. An Universitas Sebelas Maret graduate, she previously drew local attention as one of Solo’s youngest village heads when she was appointed Lurah of Keprabon in 2022.

Steven Johnsons Tjan is an F&B entrepreneur and executive associated with Petarung Group. Public profiles and interviews also identify him as a director and CEO of Boga Group Jatim, where he has spoken about service-led leadership in the restaurant business.

Ivonne Sabrina is Country Manager of LifeWave Indonesia and Chairwoman of the Surabaya Business Forum. Her career spans finance and operations, including roles at Global Emerging Markets, CFO of Indonesian game developer Touchten, and General Manager of Jeunesse Indonesia, which she says she returned to profitability after five consecutive loss-making years.

Tjahjono Haryono is President Director of PT Pangan Lestari, part of the Finna Group. He is also publicly associated with East Java’s Indonesian Café and Restaurant Entrepreneurs Association (Apkrindo), connecting his leadership to the region’s food and hospitality sector.

Ferry Setiawan is the chair of Apkrindo DPD Jawa Timur, the East Java chapter of Indonesia’s café and restaurant entrepreneurs association. Elected for the 2023–2027 term, he has publicly focused on enlarging the regional culinary-industry ecosystem and is also associated with Mantra Group.

Steven Lee Njatawidjaja is the founder and CEO of ArtGrass, established in 2013, and CEO of Midorie Indonesia. He is a business creator with a public presence across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, where he shares entrepreneurial and operational content.

Maria Septiani Sumargo is Director of GBT Laras Imbang, the Surabaya-based wheel-alignment and balancing specialist operated by PT Dinamis Selaras Abadi. She represents the third generation of the Sumargo family business and has appeared as a speaker in automotive-management programming in Surabaya.

Nysa Pratiwi, also known as Annisa Pratiwi, is CMO of Ladang Lima, the Indonesian food brand behind gluten-free cassava-based flour and snacks. As a mompreneur and brand leader, she has helped build Ladang Lima’s public identity around turning cassava into accessible healthier food products.

Monica Liando is CMO of Pura The Purest and a senior brand strategist at PURA Indonesia. She leads marketing for a natural-FMCG brand known for sea salt, Himalayan salt, seasonings, spices, and other natural food products.

Ibro Kumar, whose public profile identifies him as Risdian Kumar, is a Surabaya-based technology reviewer and content creator. Through YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, he makes practical reviews of gadgets, apps, electric vehicles, and consumer technology.
Devietha Kurnia is the founder of Yogamate, a Surabaya-based yoga community. Her work centers on making movement and wellness more accessible through shared practice and modern lifestyle programming.

Nadia Gunawan is an Indonesia-based children’s-book illustrator represented by The Bright Agency. Her warm digital illustration work has been commissioned by international publishers including HarperCollins, Penguin, Pan Macmillan, and Igloo Books.

Evan Raditya Pratomo, known as PAPERCAPTAIN, is a design lecturer and contemporary illustration designer. He is founder and visual artist of Papercaptain Studio and has presented illustration, creative-direction, and visual-art projects through his portfolio and artist channels.

Budi Haryono is the founder of Crunchaus Salads, a healthy-food business he established in 2017. Built from his interest in healthier eating, Crunchaus has become known for making fresh, crunchy salad bowls more accessible to urban diners.

Andrew Wirawan owns Cardea Surabaya and Expat. Roasters Surabaya. Alongside his Head of Strategy role at Bernofarm Pharmaceutical, he operates a Pilates and physiotherapy space focused on movement and healing and a specialty-coffee venture that emphasizes community.

Yohana Belinda is a bilingual Indonesia-based journalist and storyteller. Her reporting spans human rights, politics, fashion, and art, and has appeared in outlets including The Jakarta Post, VICE Asia, Monocle, Nikkei Asia, Rest of World, and The Japan Times.

Meiske D. Wahyu is an ICF Associate Certified Coach and Head of Partnership at Pause & Grow, where she works on strengths-based learning partnerships. Her career has included corporate law and education, and she founded the SabangMerauke student-exchange nonprofit to promote interfaith tolerance in Indonesia.

Muhammad Ali Affandi L.N.M. is Chairman of the Surabaya Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Kadin Surabaya). Re-elected for the 2024–2029 term, he has advocated for an innovative, sustainable local economy and is publicly active as an entrepreneur and social-empowerment advocate.

Stephanie Susi is the founder of I’m Not Trash, an upcycling venture that uses production waste from her husband’s warehouse as creative material. She also leads Bebocto Creative and is associated with EGM Heroes, extending her work into creative-community and sustainability initiatives.

Carla Sutanto is a creative entrepreneur and co-founder of Nuansa Concept, an event-styling and conceptual-design studio. As the studio’s Director and Lead Conceptor, she develops events, brands, and communities designed to go beyond surface aesthetics.

Chitra Astriana is co-founder of DearAstrid Psychology Service and PT Citra Balita Kirana’s BaLiTa media-franchise IP. She works on online and offline brand activation and is described by TEDxSurabaya as a driving force behind BaLiTa, while building DearAstrid into a multi-branch psychology service.

Steven Wijaya is Managing Director of Commercial Affairs at Polygon Group, the family-owned industrial company behind a global bicycle business. His work spans commercial leadership and strategy for the Surabaya-rooted company’s international markets.

Fandy Soegiarto is an illustrator and General Manager of Caravan Studio, with more than 15 years of experience in the creative industry. His studio work includes serving as production manager for The Art of JUMBO, an official Caravan Studio publication tied to the Indonesian animated film JUMBO.

Agustian Pratama is a podcaster and co-founder of Podcast Mendoan alongside Dono Pradana. He is a Surabaya-based digital creator whose show has built a substantial YouTube audience through hundreds of podcast episodes and videos.
